# runtime-attempt-report-writer

Purpose: Produce an evidence-bound runtime attempt report with truth labels and next steps; does not certify upstream stack success.

Record a chronological, secret-free runtime attempt log—including version stamps, downgrade-only truth labels, and routed next steps—for Path 1, Path 2, or CLI appendix runs. A report produced by this skill can serve as an in-repo provenance record under `docs/evals/`, without certifying artifact quality or diagnosing runtime defects.

Metadata: Contract `v1.0.0` | Category `runtime-and-execution` | Role `execution-attempt-provenance-logger` | Tier `L0` | Runtime default `Not Run` | Artifact default `Not Produced` | Mutation `downgrade_only`

## When to use & trigger cues
- after any Blender connect attempt (success or failure)
- preparing notes for `docs/evals/` style provenance
- teaching non-technical stakeholders what actually occurred
- Trigger phrases: "write up what we tried", "runtime attempt log", "postmortem blender connect", "evidence report template"

## When not to use (delegation boundaries)
- Classifying rendered or exported visual artifacts (render-export-evidence) → use `render-export-evidence` (`references/skill-render-export-evidence.md`; render-export-evidence)
- Diagnosing systematic runtime or scene defects (blender-troubleshooting) → use `blender-troubleshooting` (`references/skill-blender-troubleshooting.md`; blender-troubleshooting)
- Running pre-attempt environment checks (official-runtime-readiness-checker) → use `official-runtime-readiness-checker` (`references/skill-official-runtime-readiness-checker.md`; official-runtime-readiness-checker)
- Selecting which runtime path to use before an attempt (runtime-path-picker) → use `runtime-path-picker` (`references/skill-runtime-path-picker.md`; runtime-path-picker)
- Performing final release or delivery gating (pre-handoff-verification) → use `pre-handoff-verification` (`references/skill-pre-handoff-verification.md`; pre-handoff-verification)

## Input & output contract
- Required input `attempted_runtime_path_and_host` (`object`): Path 1, Path 2, or CLI appendix route and MCP host configuration used during the attempt
- Required input `chronological_execution_log` (`array`): Timestamped sequence of read-only or mutation tool calls, responses, and observed outcomes
- Required input `version_stamps` (`object`): Exact Blender version, add-on version, and MCP client version strings
- Optional input `pre_mutation_backup_record` (`object`): Optional .blend checkpoint backup metadata if an L1+ mutation was attempted
- Output contract: `structured_runtime_attempt_report_md`, `locked_runtime_and_artifact_truth_labels`, `eval_evidence_archival_path` (Runtime status: `Not Run`, Artifact status: `Not Produced`, `downgrade_only`).

## Quick-start steps
1. gather timestamps, commands/config surfaces touched (no secrets)
2. choose blocks from `skills/runtime-attempt-report-writer/references/truth-label-blocks.md`
3. fill `skills/runtime-attempt-report-writer/references/attempt-record-template.md`
4. route improvements via `skills/runtime-attempt-report-writer/references/triage-next-steps.md`

## Cross-skill handoffs
- [upstream_reference] Pre-attempt readiness check → `official-runtime-readiness-checker` (`references/skill-official-runtime-readiness-checker.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.path not_equals "unselected"; runtime.verifiedReady equals false]`
- [upstream_reference] Runtime path selection context → `runtime-path-picker` (`references/skill-runtime-path-picker.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.path equals "unselected"]`
- [fallback] Bridge / port / host conflicts → `runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver` (`references/skill-runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.conflictDetected equals true]`
- [fallback] Runtime or scene defect diagnosis → `blender-troubleshooting` (`references/skill-blender-troubleshooting.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.errorDetected equals true]`
- [progression] Artifact evidence classification → `render-export-evidence` (`references/skill-render-export-evidence.md`) — `when.all: [stage.current equals "post_execution_audit"]`
- [fallback] Final handoff gate & failure exit → `pre-handoff-verification` (`references/skill-pre-handoff-verification.md`) — `when.any: [gate.status equals "failed"; runtime.mode equals "blocked"]`

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- Runtime boundary: Documentation skill only—never executes Blender or generates Python. Reports must strictly preserve upstream runtime distinctions: - **Path 1**: Official Blender Lab MCP in Blender 5.1+, hosted from (a) Anthropic Connector or (b) manual MCP client. The Connector is NOT standalone. - **Path 2**: Community `mcp-for-blender` (third-party, Blender 3.0+); document only with explicit caveats and never treat as release evidence. - **CLI fallback**: Appendix only (`blender --background --python`); remains upstream-documented with no in-repo evidence file unless a report written by this skill becomes one under `docs/evals/`.
- Executing Blender, running MCP commands, or writing Python scripts.
- Certifying visual artifact quality or export integrity (owned by `render-export-evidence`).
- Diagnosing runtime crashes, bridge conflicts, or scene errors (owned by `blender-troubleshooting` and `runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver`).
- Approving final delivery packages without passing through `pre-handoff-verification`.
